name: @pipeworx/mcp-discogs

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search across Discogs (releases, masters, artists, labels). Filter by type, title, artist, format (e.g., "Vinyl", "CD"), country, year, genre, style, label.

tools.name: get_release
tools.description: Full release detail: title, artists, labels, formats, tracklist, credits, year, country, notes, identifiers (barcode, matrix), data quality.

tools.name: get_master
tools.description: Fetch master release detail by Discogs master_id — the canonical work record spanning all pressings/editions. Returns title, main release, artists, genres, styles, year, tracklist, and Discogs URL.

tools.name: get_artist
tools.description: Fetch a Discogs artist profile by artist_id. Returns name, real name, profile bio, URLs, aliases, group memberships, images, and Discogs URL.

tools.name: get_label
tools.description: Fetch a Discogs record label profile by label_id. Returns label name, profile, contact info, URLs, parent label, sublabels, and images.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-discogs forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the discogs pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
